hits.title: David Marino Sings Michel Legrand
hits.content: David Marino Sings Michel Legrand is David Marino’s new show, paying tribute to Michel Legrand’s repertoire—from chanson to jazz, including some of the greatest film themes.  | David will be accompanied by four musicians and will invite the Lithuanian artist Ieva Dudaite, with whom he recently recorded the theme from The Umbrellas of Cherbourg, to join him on stage. All the iconic pieces that made Michel Legrand one of the most beloved French composers worldwide will be featured in this concert, from The Umbrellas of Cherbourg to the theme from the film Les Uns et les Autres, as well as The Windmills of Your Mind and The Young Girls of Rochefort. A regular on American and Canadian stages, David Marino has, since October 2025, become a breakout star in Paris in the musical The Young Girls of Rochefort at the Théâtre du Lido, where he plays Maxence. His captivating charisma and enchanting voice now allow him to shine on European stages as well, after performing in some of North America’s most prestigious jazz clubs, including the legendary Birdland in New York.  | ["1h30"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Lionel Lavault Management, David Marino"]

hits.title: From Tchaikovsky to The Firebird
hits.artist: Orchestre symphonique de Montréal, Rafael Payare, Leonidas Kavakos
hits.content: Steeped in the myths that inspire it, this program radiates solar energy.  | The Firebird spreads its legendary wings—a blazing figure of rebirth and enchantment—in a sweeping orchestral fresco ignited by Stravinsky. With Elysium, Samy Moussa invokes Greco-Roman mythology to explore life’s beauty, fragility, and ethical meaning. At the heart of this triptych, Leonidas Kavakos takes on Prokofiev’s Violin Concerto no. 2, revealing its profound lyricism, wounded nobility, and intimate rhythmic poetry. An evening shaped by imaginary forces and vital energies that illuminate our inner world.This concert is also being presented as a "matinee" performance. | ["1h50 with intermission"] | [": Samy Moussa, Elysium (12min)Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, Concerto for violin op.35, TH59 in D major (33 min)_Igor Stravinsky, The Firebird (full-length ballet) (45min)","Conductor: Rafael Payare","Violin: Leonidas Kavakos (evening concerts only)","Production \/ Presentation: Orchestre symphonique de Montréal (OSM)"]

hits.title: Jimmy Carr | Laughs Funny
hits.content: Fan favourite Jimmy Carr returns to Montreal as part of his fifth and most ambitious cross-Canada tour yet, Jimmy Carr: Laughs Funny.  | Known worldwide for his lightning-quick wit, dark one-liners and unmistakable laugh, Jimmy Carr remains one of the most successful and best-selling comedians. A master of razor-sharp humour, he has toured to over 40 countries, sold millions of tickets, and continues to be one of the most streamed stand-ups of the last decade. His most recent tour, Terribly Funny 2.0, surpassed one million tickets worldwide and saw him perform 293 shows across 145 cities in a single year—cementing his reputation as one of the hardest-working acts in comedy.  | ["1h - 1h30"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Outback Presents"]

hits.title: The World of Stravinsky
hits.artist: Orchestre symphonique de Montréal, Rafael Payare, Leonidas Kavakos
hits.content: A concert is always a quest: a search for an ideal light born from the intense encounter between artists who come together for only a few rehearsals. This same search for light runs through the entire program.  | For this "matinee" version program, Elysium, premiered in 2021, Samy Moussa explores an inner, spiritual radiance inspired by the sacred realm of Greek mythology, a place of peace and transcendence. In contrast, Stravinsky’s The Firebird, first performed in Paris in 1910 by the Ballets Russes, ignites light from the shimmering feathers of its legendary, fiery creature. All of it unfolds in a blazing orchestral display under the direction of Rafael Payare.This concert is also presented in its entirety. | ["1h50 with intermission (evening) | 1h without intermission (matinée)"] | [": Samy Moussa, Elysium (12 min)_Igor Stravinsky, The Firebird (full-length ballet) (45 min)","Conductor: Rafael Payare","Production \/ Presentation: Orchestre symphonique de Montréal (OSM)"]

hits.title: Légendes de l’Olympia en opéra
hits.content: Légendes de l’Olympia en opéra is a live tribute concert celebrating Édith Piaf, Céline Dion and Dalida, three performers whose songs have resonated across generations. | Presented in the Cinquième Salle, the concert brings together a lyrical voice, piano and cello in an intimate format that keeps the melodies and lyrics at the centre of the performance. New arrangements revisit beloved songs from the distinct repertoires of Piaf, Dion and Dalida. The vocal performance is supported by the warmth of the piano and the depth of the cello while preserving the emotional character of the original works.With elegant, cinematic staging, the programme brings the different eras and musical worlds of these three artists into one evening. The concert invites audiences to rediscover songs that have become enduring landmarks of francophone music. | ["1h30 with intermission"] | ["Vocals: Lucia","Cello: Keith Lau","Piano: Chapmann Wong","Production \/ Presentation: Laymoun"]

hits.title: Pierre-Yves Roy-Desmarais | Une année en un an
hits.content: After winning the Olivier Awards for Show of the Year and Writer of the Year, as well as the Félix Award for Comedy Show of the Year, Pierre-Yves Roy-Desmarais takes his art to the next level with his second show.  | One evening, when he least expects it, Pierre-Yves Roy-Desmarais experiences an event that will change the course of his life. He tries, as best he can, to keep control of his life, but time becomes blurry, memories start to blend together, and units of measurement stop making sense. With everything that’s happening to him, he feels like he’s living the equivalent of a full year — in just one year. Une année en un an is a show combining stand-up, songs, and cheese, lasting 75 centimeters.  | ["Yes","1h30 without intermission","French"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Productions KOScène Inc."]

hits.title: Mariza | The Star of Fado
hits.content: To the great delight of Montréal audiences and the Portuguese community, the celebrated fadista Mariza returns to the Maison Symphonique for a concert eagerly awaited for more than eight years. An icon of 21st-century Lusophone music, she has established herself as one of the most powerful and moving voices on the international stage.  | Since Amália Rodrigues, few Portuguese artists have enjoyed such a brilliant international career. Mariza has graced the world’s most prestigious stages, earning critical acclaim and receiving numerous international awards and distinctions. Born in Mozambique and raised in Mouraria, the historic Lisbon neighbourhood closely linked to the birth of fado, Mariza grew up in a world where voices, guitars, and stories of life shaped the soul of this music. From an early age, she embraced this heritage and carried it into a universal dimension. Gifted with an extraordinary voice and natural charisma, she first captivated Lisbon before quickly becoming an international phenomenon. For more than two decades, Mariza has performed on the great stages of the world, from North America to Asia, from Europe to Latin America, carrying with her the soul and sensibility of Portugal. Her remarkable career includes more than fifty platinum records, several Grammy Award nominations, and critical recognition that places her among the great voices of world music. Heir to the tradition of fado while resolutely looking toward the future, Mariza embodies a living vision of this musical heritage. On stage, her presence and the depth of her interpretation transform every performance into a rare experience, where the emotion of fado is shared in all its truth.  | ["1h15 with intermission"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Traquen'Art"]

hits.title: JF Otis | Avec plaisir!
hits.content: Comedian JF Otis officially presents his very first one-man show: With Pleasure! This outstanding storyteller, a proud representative of the Rimouski region (more precisely, Saint-Anaclet-de-Lessard) and self-proclaimed "specialist in making average decisions," has truly found his place on stage with this first show, where he cultivates the pride of his regional identity with disarming charisma.  | His incredible gift of the gab and his natural yet irresistible magnetism allow him to attract a wide audience who can't help but embrace him and his authentic humor.With a phenomenal social media presence, JF Otis has accumulated an impressive total of nearly 225,000 followers across his platforms, including 130,000 on TikTok, where his comedy clips have garnered over 3.6 million likes. Building on this viral popularity, JF Otis is now brilliantly transposing the richness of his universe onto the stage with his first one-man show. The delicious humor that made him a success, whether it's his hilarious advice on life as a couple, his personal and family anecdotes, or his heartfelt tributes to demanding professions, are at the heart of Avec plaisir! (With pleasure!). Always unifying and deeply engaging, the comedian subtly explores a variety of topics with an accessible and straightforward approach in a classic stand-up routine."This show is an invitation to spend quality time together, since it's Avec plaisir (With pleasure) that I take the stage every night to share my stories, my observations... and above all, to hear you laugh. You should also know that my stories are often inspired by my family, a veritable gallery of characters! My parents, my sister, my grandmother, my uncle... they fuel my humor every day." Honestly, I'm far from being the funniest in my group, now it's up to you to judge!" - JF OtisJF Otis, who co-wrote the show with comedian and veteran author Simon Delisle, invites the audience to a warm, festive atmosphere, as if we were all around a campfire, sharing anecdotes with an old friend! | ["French"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Agence Comico"]

hits.title: Loreena McKennitt | The Mask and Mirror – Anniversary Tour
hits.content: In fall 2026, award-winning Canadian singer/songwriter, Loreena McKennitt, will be commemorating the 30th anniversary of her album, The Mask and Mirror, with an extensive tour of Eastern Canada. Widely acclaimed for its ‘cross-cultural fertilization’, the album weaves together Celtic, Spanish and Moroccan influences.  | Loreena will be accompanied by musical companions Caroline Lavelle on cello, Brian Hughes on guitar, Hugh Marsh on violin, Dudley Phillips on bass and Robert Brian on drums. The first set each evening will feature fan favourites, while the second set will include every song on the album.McKennitt proclaims, “This is a milestone anniversary in my career, and I look forward to celebrating it at home.”  Her eclectic Celtic blend of pop, folk and world music has sold more than 14 million albums worldwide, and her recordings have achieved Gold, Platinum and multi-Platinum status in 15 countries, on four continents.  | ["English"] | ["Cello: Caroline Lavelle","Guitar: Brian Hughes","Violin: Hugh Marsh","Bass: Dudley Phillips","Drums: Robert Brian","Production \/ Presentation: Rubin Fogel Productions"]

hits.title: Opening Gala with Dawn Tyler Watson
hits.content: To celebrate its 11th edition, Festival Stella Musica, under the artistic direction of pianist Katarzyna Musiał, opens with a vibrant evening bringing together outstanding women from different cultures, generations, and musical worlds. | This evening will be headlined by Dawn Tyler Watson. A JUNO Award winner and recipient of numerous prestigious distinctions, she is one of the leading voices of Canadian blues. She captivates audiences with her stage presence and her unique style, which blends blues, jazz, soul, gospel, and rock.She will be joined by exceptional guests, including Djely Tapa, a two-time JUNO Award-winning Canadian-Malian singer-songwriter who bridges West African traditions with contemporarysonorities. Coming from a family of griots, she blends West African musical traditions with contemporary sounds. Rachel Therrien, an internationally renowned, GRAMMY-nominated jazz trumpet player and composer; Cécile Doo-Kingué, an award-winning guitarist and singer-songwriter influenced by blues, soul, jazz, and Afro-roots; and the up-and-coming Montreal singer-songwriter Rachel Dara complete the lineup.From blues and jazz to West African influences, soul, and contemporary songwriting, this colourful evening celebrates artistic encounters, cultural diversity, and the power of women in music. | ["2h with intermission"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Stella Musica Festival"]

Rachel Therrien, an internationally renowned, GRAMMY-nominated jazz trumpet player and composer; Cécile Doo-Kingué, an award-winning guitarist and singer-songwriter influenced by blues, soul, jazz, and Afro-roots; and the up-and-coming Montreal singer-songwriter Rachel Dara complete the lineup.From blues and jazz to West African influences, soul, and contemporary songwriting, this colourful evening celebrates artistic encounters, cultural diversity, and the power of women in music. | ["2h with intermission"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Stella Musica Festival"]

hits.title: Grand Concert
hits.content:
For its 11th edition, Festival Stella Musica, under the artistic direction of Katarzyna Musiał, presents a vibrant celebration of women in music and the arts.
 | As the Festival's flagship event, the Grand Concert invites audiences on an evocative odyssey of music and expressive movement. Its uplifting and diverse programming features exceptional artists, notably the award-winning soprano Karoline Podolak, the fiery energy of Ensemble Fuego Flamenco, Principal Dancer with Les Grands Ballets Canadiens Rachele Buriassi, krump dance prodigy Adeline Kerry Cruz, and captivating visuals by Dali Wu.Through a rich dialogue between opera, classical music, flamenco, dance, and contemporary forms of expression, the Grand Concert shines a light on women in music and the arts while celebrating artistic excellence and the transformative power of live performance. | ["2h with intermission"] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Festival Stella Musica"]

hits.title: Le fantôme dans la machine
hits.content: Invited onto a television set, Rousse gets the surprise of her life: the team has planned a live reunion with her brother, whom she hasn’t seen for 29 years.  | The problem is, he died in a fire in 1997. Is it a hallucination? A tasteless stunt? Are they trying to rattle her for the sake of “good TV”? But then her brother appears to her again in other unlikely places, to catch up, pick up the conversation where they left off, and tease her just like he used to. These encounters give Rousse a glimpse of the life she might have had if her brother had survived the tragedy, or, rather, the many versions of lives unlived that unfold in parallel universes. These discoveries come with unsettling questions: would she be willing to give up the life she has now to keep her beloved brother alive and by her side? Directed by Alexia Bürger (Les Hardings, Les filles du Saint Laurent, Camera obscura), who has shared a bond since childhood and a rich artistic partnership with author Fanny Britt (Bienveillance, Hurlevents, Classique(s)), this “auto-science-fiction” blurs the boundaries between fiction and reality, exploring the ways in which the dead continue to haunt the living. Between intimate confession and dramatic invention, both autobiographical and pure fabulation, this play about the power of imagination explores how writing and the stage are a chance to re-enact a formative tragedy of a life. With bittersweet irony, Britt and Bürger draw us into a world where memory and theatrical illusion intertwine to explore the stories we choose to believe. | ["French","November 12, 2026","November 13, 2026"] | ["Text: Fanny Britt","Stage Direction: Alexia Bürger","Interpretation: Anne-Élisabeth Bossé, Patrice Dubois, Simon Lacroix, Christophe Levac","Dramaturgy: Chloé Gagné Dion","Staging Assistance: Stéphanie Capistran-Lalonde","Scenography and Lighting Design: Martin Labrecque","Costumes: Elen Ewing","Music: Philippe Brault","Props: Julie Measroch","Makeup and hairstyling: Justine Denoncourt-Bélanger","Movement: Jamie Wright","Video: Béatrice Germain","Production \/ Presentation: Duceppe","Collaboration: Place des Arts"]

hits.title: Christos Papadopoulos | My Fierce Ignorant Step
hits.content: Relentless pulsations, synchronized energies. At once dynamic and meditative, My Fierce Ignorant Step unfolds as an ecstatic soundscape, bursting with the contagious bliss of being alive. | Exploring the unison and cohesion of the group, Greek choreographer Christos Papadopoulos captivates audiences with works where bodies move as one, vibrating with intensity. A rising presence on the European scene, he fascinates with the precision of his choral compositions. My Fierce Ignorant Step draws its initial spark from the sonic memories of his childhood in Greece. How do we recapture that youthful sense of invincibility? The dancers pulse with fearless joy, guided by collective memories of a time when everything felt possible. Despite the group’s unstoppable drive, individualities surface. Echoes, voices, and bodies intertwine like instruments. Gradually, the choreography and score—composed by Kornilios Selamsis—gain momentum, propelled by the breath and vocal impulses of the performers. Until they reach collective euphoria. Exhilarating! | ["1h05 without intermission","Contains strobe effects"] | ["Choreography: Christos Papadopoulos","Music: Kornilios Selamsis","Production \/ Presentation: Danse Danse"]

hits.title: Nosferatu the Vampire in Cine-Concert
hits.content: Distorted sets, haunting shadows, creatures beyond the realm of reality—Nosferatu the Vampire brings together every hallmark of the German Expressionist masterpiece. Directed in 1922 by Friedrich Wilhelm Murnau, this silent film—the first major adaptation of Bram Stoker’s Dracula—has lost none of its hypnotic power. | Presented with a fully improvised live score on the Grand Orgue Pierre-Béique, it reveals a heightened dramatic intensity. Jason Roberts unleashes a vivid sonic palette, capable of colouring each scene—from simmering tension to sweeping surges of sound—most notably during the film’s famous, fateful sea voyage. A sensory experience in which image and music merge to spark a shiver that endures more than a century after the film’s release. | ["Concert with projection","1h40 without intermission"] | [": Nosferatu (1922), directed by F. W. Murnau","Organ: Jason Roberts","Production \/ Presentation: Orchestre symphonique de Montréal (OSM)"]

hits.title: Midsummer Night Dreams
hits.content:
From William Shakespeare’s ancient Greek forest to Guillaume Côté’s contemporary creation, Midsummer Night Dreams has transcended the centuries without losing any of its mystery.
 | Here, the choreographer sets this enchanted comedy during a wedding celebration over the course of a weekend. The union seems peaceful at first, until everything begins to unravel. Four young lovers see their relationships put to the test by a mischievous figure and a magical love potion. In this wild landscape, which gradually transforms into a chaotic and enchanted world, Guillaume Côté offers a deeply human reimagining of Shakespeare’s 1595 play.At the heart of the work lies a simple and disarming question: what becomes of love over time? The choreographer explores the cracks in love, the wear and tear of long relationships, the fragility of human bonds, and that desire that persists despite fatigue, jealousy, and misunderstanding. A former principal dancer, Guillaume Côté unfolds a choreographic language that is both incisive and deeply embodied, rooted in classical rigour. The score weaves a vibrant dialogue between Mendelssohn, the prodigy of German Romanticism, Max Richter, Steve Reich, and Johann Strauss, while the staging gradually shifts from almost raw realism into the realm of pure dream.A night to lose oneself, confront one’s desires, and perhaps find oneself again. | ["With orchestra"] | ["Choreography: Guillaume Côté","Music: Tommy Lunaire, Felix Mendelssohn, Steve Reich, Johann Strauss II, Max Richter, Erik Satie, Claude Debussy","Conductor: Dina Gilbert","Orchestra: Les Grands Ballets Orchestra","Sets: Michael Gianfrancesco","Costumes: Rémi Van Bochove","Lighting Design: Sonoyo Nishikawa","Production \/ Presentation: Les Grands Ballets"]

hits.title: Miles Smiles - Wayne Shines
hits.content: On the 100th anniversary of Miles Davis's birth and in lasting tribute to Wayne Shorter, Miles Smiles – Wayne Shines returns to the stage. | From 1965 to 1968, Davis and Shorter's Second Great Quintet—with Hancock, Carter, and Williams—produced some of the most audacious music of the century. Composer Jean-Nicolas Trottier has taken that legacy further: building original jazz symphonies from Shorter's melodic cells and rhythmic figures—not arrangements, but new compositions in dialogue with the source. Premiered in 2019 at L'Astral and released as a live album in 2023—named best large ensemble album of the year by the Ottawa Citizen—the work returns, revealing an architecture only hinted at in the original recordings. | ["1h20 without intermission"] | ["Composition: Jean-Nicolas Trottier","Orchestra: Orchestre national de jazz de Montréal","Production \/ Presentation: Production ONJ"]

hits.title: Sounds of the East
hits.content: Sounds of the East is a live tribute concert celebrating the music of Sayed Darwish, Abdel Halim Hafez and Mohammed Abdu, three defining figures whose repertoires have accompanied generations across the Arab world. | Presented in the Cinquième Salle at Place des Arts and performed live by Toronto-based Hikaya Band, the concert brings new life to songs that have become enduring classics.Each song tells a story and awakens a memory. Through powerful vocals, rich arrangements and timeless melodies, Hikaya Band takes audiences on a musical journey shaped by love, longing, joy and resilience.With an elegant, cinematic presentation, the concert celebrates Arabic music and its ability to connect people across generations and cultures. Audiences are invited to rediscover beloved classics together through a vivid and deeply felt live performance. | ["2h with intermission","English"] | ["Interpretation: Hikaya Band","Production \/ Presentation: Laymoun"]

hits.title: Mariachi Herencia de Mexico | La nueva generación tour
hits.content: Discover a new generation of mariachis and immerse yourself in the heart of Mexican music and culture! Presented in celebration of the Day of the Dead (Día de Muertos), this electrifying performance honours the past, present and future. A Montréal premiere! | Come celebrate this colourful Mexican tradition, where music brings generations together and keeps alive the memory of those who came before us. A festive and heartwarming experience to share with family and friends!The group will perform some of its greatest hits while also drawing from the traditional repertoire associated with Día de Muertos. Discover iconic songs from this Mexican celebration, reimagined with the energy and passion of Mariachi Herencia de México.Twice nominated for a Latin GRAMMY® Award, Mariachi Herencia de Mexico pushes the boundaries of music and the rich mariachi tradition of Guadalajara and Mexico City. Composed of 14 musicians, this young virtuoso group from Chicago has become a major voice for a new bicultural generation in the United States. A festive event for the whole family!Since the release of their debut album, Nuestra Herencia, in 2017, which topped the Latin streaming charts and earned them a Latin GRAMMY® Award nomination, they have released five successful albums, toured extensively across North America, and garnered acclaim for their innovative and dynamic sound. Their 2022 album, Herederos, was nominated for a 2023 Latin GRAMMY® Award for Best Ranchero/Mariachi Album. | [] | ["Production \/ Presentation: Place des Arts"]

hits.title: Entre chiens et louves
hits.content: Pianist and composer Alexandra Stréliski accompanies the artists of Cirque Le Roux on stage for this dazzling show, featuring a musical score of her own works and other equally captivating pieces. Presented exclusively at Place des Arts, this unique version of Entre chiens et louves promises to be a memorable experience.  | Entre chiens et louves (Between Dogs and Wolves) immerses the audience in a historical epic that reveals the intimacy of three characters living in different eras: 1850, 1960, and 2026. Tracing their journeys, the piece is a staggering excursion through time, taking us right up to the present day, evoking the collective memories that make us who we are—filled with revolt and emancipation—but which still divide us today. A true testament to the human condition, the piece depicts a world full of hope, of bodies in motion, offering a glimpse of the forgotten who are just waiting to be reborn. Conceived much like a film in which the scenes unfold, the piece gives free rein to eight virtuosos who draw us into an epic adventure blending comedy, spectacular acrobatics, and dance with an impetus that is profoundly human and supportive. Accompanied by string duo Julia and Natalia Kotarba and electronic musician Jimbo Canoville, Alexandra Stréliski will perform four of her own compositions — two from Néo-Romance and two created for Entre chiens et louves — along with classics by Schubert, Chopin, Pergolesi, Vivaldi, Beethoven and Nina Simone. A Montreal premiere that will bring a new dimension to this critically acclaimed production, which has been performed more than 250 times across Europe.Cirque Le Roux Founded in France in 2014, Cirque Le Roux is renowned for its originality, refined aesthetics, narrative power, and exceptional technical virtuosity. Always seeking to innovate, this contemporary circus company brings together artists from various countries and diverse backgrounds, many of whom studied at the National Circus School in Montreal, where they met Alexandra Stréliski. By blending acrobatics, theatre, and humour, Cirque Le Roux creates unique shows that redefine the conventions of the modern circus.  | ["1h20 without intermission","Press Premiere"] | ["Artistic, Visual, and Acrobatic Direction: Cirque Le Roux  ","Stage Direction: Cirque Le Roux, Charlotte Saliou","Choreography: Maria Carolina Vieira","Text: Léonard Kahn","Scenography: Cirque Le Roux, Benoît Probst","Costumes: Cirque Le Roux, Clarisse Baudinière","Lighting Design: Pierre Berneron","Sound: Jimbo Canoville","Music: Alexandra Stréliski ","Production Management: Juliette Grandmottet","Assistant Stage Director: Nina Quitté","Interpretation: Philip Rosenberg, Kaisha Dessalines-Wright, Mathilde Jimenez, Tristan Nielsen, Maude Parent, Greg Arsenal, Yannick Thomas, Samuel Charlton","On-Stage Musical Performers: Alexandra Stréliski, Julia Kotarba, Natalia Kotarba, Jimbo Canoville ","Diffusion: Place des Arts","Co-production: Le Bon Marché Rive Gauche, Cirque Le Roux","Collaboration: La Presse","Support: Consulat général de France à Québec","Media partner: Radio-Canada"]

hits.title: Narrators of Peace | Worlds of the past, present, and future!
hits.content: True to its vocation of traversing the territories where memory and culture meet in dialogue, the Festival du Monde Arabe presents Narrators of Peace, a living musical project that explores music's power to bring people together across cultural and social borders. | Custodian of a centuries-old heritage, Navāk Ensemble unfolds an art in which every note rises like a meditation, a dialogue suspended between the timelessness of ancient modes and the vertigo of the present moment. Their music does more than recreate the past: it releases its living force, bringing it into resonance with melodic influences, rhythms, and musical ideas drawn from other traditions around the world.At the crossroads of ancestral tradition and the contemporary stage, this performance offers a rare sensory experience, a space of grace where the breath of music dissolves distance and connects souls. | ["1h45 with intermission","French"] | ["Ensemble: Navāk Ensemble","Production \/ Presentation: Festival du Monde Arabe"]
